title: SSC CGL Maths: Topic-wise Previous Year Questions
what: Past SSC CGL maths questions grouped into 26 chapters, from percentage and profit-loss through algebra, trigonometry, geometry, mensuration, DI and statistics.

title: English Topic-wise Questions for SSC CGL
what: Practice sets for every English question type: error spotting, narration, idioms, one-word substitution, spellings, synonyms, antonyms, blanks, sentence improvement, para jumbles, voice and five comprehension passages.

title: One Word Substitution: 1600+ Words
what: An alphabetical list of more than 1,600 one-word substitutions with English meanings and Hindi equivalents.

title: Idioms & Phrases Asked in SSC Exams
what: Idioms and phrases that appeared in past SSC papers (up to CGL 2016), each tagged with the exam it came from, with repeats kept to show what recurs.

title: Idioms & Phrases Capsule
what: A short, numbered list of common idioms and their meanings for last-minute revision.

title: General Awareness MCQ Book (Free GA Book)
what: Solved GA multiple-choice questions on art and culture, Indian and international awards, books and authors, sports and miscellaneous topics, with hints and solutions.

title: Static GK 2026 (GK Now)
what: Static GK tables: superlatives and firsts, national parks, dances, rivers, dams, stadiums, ports, heritage sites, crops, full forms, institutions, awards, inventions, books, forts, military exercises and 2025 Nobel winners.

title: General Knowledge Notes: History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science
what: Short notes on ancient, medieval and modern Indian history, world and Indian geography, environment, polity, economy and general science.

title: General Science MCQ E-book (SSB Crack)
what: A general science overview followed by explained MCQs and practice quizzes in physics, chemistry and biology, plus previous-year questions.

title: Current Affairs One-liners & MCQs, Jan–Jun 2026 (GK Now)
what: Current affairs for January to June 2026, month by month: one-liners, MCQs with explanations and a Who's Who list.

title: Current Affairs One-liners & MCQs, Mar–Aug 2026 (GK Now)
what: Dated current-affairs one-liners by category, 600+ MCQs with explanations, and a Who's Who updated to 31 August 2026.

title: English Topic-wise PDF: All 2022 MCQs
what: All English questions from the 2022 SSC exams, sorted by topic. Too large to host here (47 MB), so it opens on the source page.

title: SSC English Solved Papers (Disha)
what: Topic-wise English questions from SSC CGL, CHSL, CPO, MTS and Steno papers. It is a Disha Publication book (all rights reserved), so it is linked, not hosted.

title: One Word Substitution: 85 Practice Sets
what: 85 solved sets of 10 one-word-substitution MCQs drawn from about 15 years of SSC papers. It is a published book (Lalit Kumar), so it is linked, not hosted.

title: SscAce Vocabulary & Idioms Handbook
what: 105 high-frequency words with meanings, synonyms and antonyms, plus 66 idioms. The file says it is not for redistribution, so it is linked, not hosted.

title: General Studies One-liner Q&A (English)
what: Mixed one-line GK questions and answers across history, polity, geography and science. It is 13 MB, over the 12 MB hosting limit, so it is linked, not hosted.

title: Reasoning Notes: Series, Analogy and Word Test (Testbook)
what: Testbook's free SSC reasoning material in one file: worked-example notes on number, letter and letter-number series and on analogies, plus the free SmartBook sample chapter with 200 SSC-style alphabet and word-order questions, an answer key and full solutions.

title: Reasoning Concepts and Tricks by Topic (sscstudy)
what: Ajay Gulia's short concept notes (English with Hindi) for SSC reasoning: every coding-decoding type, ranking formulas, direction and distance, sitting arrangement, and logical order of words, each with a solved example.

title: Reasoning Practice Sets with Answer Keys
what: A free coaching-centre practice book of roughly 900 questions in 16 chapters, most ending in an answer key; the level is closer to bank exams, and a few chapters (input-output, assumptions, course of action) are not in the CGL syllabus.

title: Reasoning Shortcut Tricks
what: Short trick write-ups with solved examples: syllogism by the all/some/no cases with possibility and either-or rules, circular seating, blood-relation terms and family-tree symbols, series logic types, plus coded inequalities and input-output.
